matched_case_studies.case: Beta Logistica (National Freight & Interport Logistics Network)
matched_case_studies.historical_roi: Career site conversion jumped +76% (from 2.1% to 3.7%), application abandonment fell from 58% to 29%, and Time-to-Hire dropped by 31% (from 52 days to 36 days), substantially cutting external agency costs.
matched_case_studies.outcome_use: Historical sandbox outcome for context. Challenge telemetry is synthetic and this score is a retrieval heuristic.
matched_case_studies.transfer_scope: Transfer the shared mechanisms. Check workforce and site fit before adapting interventions.

supporting_research_snippets.limitation: An unattributed media cost estimate is not realized ROI.

supporting_research_snippets.finding: Accessible forms use necessary inputs, clear labels and recoverable errors.
supporting_research_snippets.limitation: Design guidance, with no universal completion-time target or effect size.

supporting_research_snippets.finding: Reputation, job and company information, and site vividness interacted in business students’ perceptions of recruiting firms.
supporting_research_snippets.limitation: Perceptions from this sample do not establish a site-specific applicant conversion effect.

supporting_research_snippets.source: Corporate Career Portal UX & Conversion Study
supporting_research_snippets.finding: When an application flow requires account creation and more than 4 form screens on mobile devices, abandonment rates among frontline logistics, retail, and healthcare candidates exceed 58%. Switching to a 60-second mobile fast-apply reduces bounce rates by 30-35%.
supporting_research_snippets.limitation: Supplied sandbox reference. Verify the magnitude and applicability independently.

supporting_research_snippets.source: B2B Employee Advocacy & Earned Media Study
supporting_research_snippets.finding: Employee ambassador posts generate 5x to 8x higher organic engagement than corporate brand pages, while automated tracking reclaims 8 to 20 hours/month of manual HR spreadsheet work and delivers auditable Earned Media Value (EMV) for CFO budget reviews.
supporting_research_snippets.limitation: Supplied sandbox reference. Verify the magnitude and applicability independently.

supporting_research_snippets.source: Executive HR Budget & CFO Governance Survey
supporting_research_snippets.finding: 78% of HR budget requests for Employer Branding are rejected or cut because HR presents vanity metrics (likes/reach) instead of Financial Turnover Risk (EUR), Cost-per-Hire savings, and Earned Media Value (EMV).
supporting_research_snippets.limitation: Supplied sandbox reference. Verify the magnitude and applicability independently.
